title: Man Is Limited by His Knowledge
body:
Dastoor. Astaghfirullah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Alfu
salaat, alfu salaam `alayka wa `ala aalika wa sahaabatika wa `ala at-tabi`een yaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l`Akhireen. Ishfa` lana ya Rasoolullah ya HabeebAllah!. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Madad madad, madad
madad, madad madad yaa Saahib al Imdaad! Who is responsible for humans on this planet, we are giving our
salute also to him and his companions that they are under his wings! Mu'mineen, believers cannot be
touched with any badness or adhaa; they can not be harmed. If we can reach their full protection, our lives
will be hayyatun tayyiba, “Best life style.” Huuuuuu.
O People! As salaamu `alaykum. Crowding in here so many heedless, drunk people. (Mawlana speaks
Turkish). It is a praising for our Turkish people, that they are understanding what I am saying and they are
very happy with my swearing at them first! Are all of you happy, yes? Those who are unhappy can go to
Jahannam, Hell! You must be very happy that you are not created as a donkey. Does a donkey complain? No,
it is very happy that it is shouting! Allah Almighty says (Mawlana Shaykh stands) "He is the only One Who
makes His servants to laugh, to be happy and not to be happy, to cry.” Laughing and crying is from Allah
Almighty to His servants. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. May

Allah forgive us. Be happy that we have been created from Mankind, the most honored creature. No one is
created with more honor after human beings, who are on the top position of all the creatures and everything
in existence. And they are happy, thanking to Allah Almighty and glorifying Him. If atoms are not glorifying
they can't be in existence. Each atom has a special personality; it can't be the same as the second one or else
all atoms will be as only one atom. Why they are different? Millions, billions, quadrillions are created, and
each one knows Who created them and how to glorify Him!
••••• •••• •••••• ••••••••• •••••••••••••
kullu qad `alimat tasbeehah, Everything knows a special glorifying for their Creator. (Al-Nour 24:41)
Maa `azhama shaanak ya rabbu 'l-`azhamah. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar.
And the crown of sultanate is granted to Mankind. And also, each one from Mankind has a secret praising, a
sirr. What one has been granted, the other is not granted. Everyone is granted from heavenly treasures.
Heavenly Treasure Oceans of Allah Almighty are endless. And Man has been granted such a secret for
themselves, and this is only for one man! The same is not granted to the second one, no. And His creation is
from pre-Eternal up to Eternal, creating and granting treasures.Allah Almighty is saying: (Mawlana Shaykh
stands)
innamaa amruhu idhaa araada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoon.
Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "Be!" and it is. (YaSeen, 36:82)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) That is the Willpower of Allah Almighty, which is only for Him. Siffat dhaatiyya, His
Divinely Attribute, "His Absolute Will." There is no shareek for Allah, no partner. He grants and no one can
be partner with Him!. yaa Rabbanaa maa `azhama shaanak. Allah Almighty is beyond our understanding
area. He is Absolute; He can't be reached, no one can reach to anything. And He is Almighty, the Creator, He
does not make a photocopy. Even every atom has a special being. For example, don't atoms of hydrogen are
the same. No. Each one has a special condition, a special area for it to be in existence. And now people who
are saying, "We have reached the top of science," I am asking them, what is your opinion? Whether anything
in existence, is standing through space or sitting? No one can answer that. No, but for each atom there is a
special area, muntaqa, the area that belongs to that atom and no one knows about it. And that atom is unique

in its creation, fareedun fee khalqihi, a second atom will not be like the first one. Therefore, sometimes
scientists say, "First, second, third, fourth," they can add, but each number is different. Two is not the same
as one; three is not same as two. Therefore, each one of them is in their unique situation in Creation.
••••• •••••••• ••••••• ••••• ••••••••
Wa maa qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi, No just estimate have they made of Allah, such as is due to Him.
(Surah Az-Zumar, 39:67)
Astaghfirullah. Therefore, so many times now they are making some servants to speak on the Oneness of
Allah Almighty and His Divinely Existence. How can you understand the Divinely Existence? An atom cannot
understand the second atom, even if they both are hydrogen atoms. Oxygen atoms are saying about hydrogen
atoms, "Who is that one?” Come together, then you will understand what is happening. When they come
together, it becomes another creature that makes the power of life. They are saying, "How did we become like
this? It is not like us. We were a different kind, but we came together not with our own will or command.
Someone is making us come together and we don’t know what is happening.” Oxygen and hydrogen are
disappearing and something new is coming that they do not understand.
They say, “What is that?”
“It is water.”
“What is water?”
“What is its real being? Two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom (H2O). It doesn't look like us.”
Therefore, now people are becoming so proud with their very small knowledge. They never understand real
positions, yet they are so mutakabbir, proud ones, and they know nothing. Such questions are sometimes
coming to me. You are a professor, are you understanding? What is your ability to understand? You can't say
anything. How is the secret power of life being put in water:
••••••••••• •••• ••••••• ••••• •••••• •••••
wa ja`alna min al-maa'i kulla shayin hayy, We made from water every living thing. (Al-Anbiya, 21:30)
Allah Almighty is saying, “We are putting the secret of life in water, without water there can’t be life.”
Therefore, people are looking, searching in so many planets for water, to find something living, but they are

never finding anything, because there is no order for water to come into existance and create life on that
planet. Nothing can be done without their Creator's order, without their Creator's iraada, Will.
O People! Now all the nations are so proud about what they know, yet they don’t know anything. They are
only saying, for example, but that reality is in another reality; oceans in oceans. Therefore, we must surrender
to our Creator; we must bow before our Creator, and it is the most simple `ilaam, to show Allah Almighty,
"We are falling into sajdah for what You have granted us to understand." Mashaa-Allah. Now people are
saying, “We are living in a scientific century.” But what they are saying in science now can’t bring an answer
or an understanding, and they can't change it. He is saying, "I am the Creator; no one can argue or struggle
with Me." Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar!
From two small beings, from men and women, coming together and getting out a perfect Creation. What is
that secret power? Who is doing that? But people are now drunk ones. Shaytan is making them drunk, saying,
"Don't think on such a thing." Why? They are saying there is a Mendeleev table, Periodic Table and it has 99
elements. Beyond that, is there nothing, only 99? There may be a thousand, ten thousand, or a million
elements! With only His order, “Be!” and so many different beings may come in existance and their table
might have billions of elements! He is Allah Almighty.
O People! Give your most high respect for your Creator; we must give. Therefore, every trouble comes from
people who are not learning. And our governments don’t take any care for teaching youngsters so that they
understand something. All of them are trying not to teach people anything, because their headmaster is
Shaytan and he is occupying their understanding, saying, “No need.” And that must be known. Allahu Qadir,
He can do everything! He can put the whole world, even one billion worlds He can put in an atom and they
may run like this. Therefore, Islam is coming first of all to teach about the Creator. Aamanto billahi wa
mala`ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, I believed in Allah and His angels and His Books and His Prophets.
First, Mankind must believe in their Creator, Allah Almighty, that He can do everything. Allahu Akbar wa
lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar.
O Allah! Send us who can send away Shaytan and its followers and can destroy shaytanic tricks and traps,
who can put your holy order on Earth so that we can follow it to make You happy with us.
Fatihah.

Yaa Sultan al-Awliyaa!
May Allah forgive us. Allah, Allah.
